scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Shallow scan. Passive, unauthenticated checks of DNS, the public surface, TLS and CORS. Quick and light, built for frequent runs.

probe.name: Probe
probe.description: Medium scan. Every passive check plus authenticated testing across two roles, with session, access-control and AI/LLM checks.

siege.name: Siege
siege.description: Deep scan. Every agent and all four logins, including business-logic and privilege-escalation testing, with the fullest non-destructive report.

attack.name: Attack
attack.description: Aggressive scan. Every agent and all four logins, with destructive, load-generating and denial-of-service testing permitted. Only run against a target whose owner has confirmed tested backups and a disaster-recovery plan.
